# minimp3

Source: https://github.com/lieff/minimp3
Pinned revision: ea99364f61c14656440e8d77e9c233ccf3124633

License: CC0 1.0 Universal; full dedication and terms retained in LICENSE, header notice preserved.
Used only to decode imported MP3 bytes locally, outside the audio callback. No encoder, network service, or system codec is required at runtime. The adapter in Source/Mp3Decoder.cpp is original project code.
